meta.title: Build Your Event
meta.description: Pick your room size, choose draping setups, preview in 3D Studio, and submit a planning brief — no pricing until we review your venue.

hub.title: Build your event
hub.description: Room size → visual catalog → colors → Studio 3D preview → submit your planning brief.

flow.title: Build your event draping plan
flow.description: Answer a few questions, pick setups from our visual catalog, then open Studio to preview in 3D before you submit.
flow.editDescription: Update room details, setups, and fabric choices, then save your revised brief.

draftBanner.title: Resume your in-progress plan?
draftBanner.description: We found an event plan draft saved in this browser. Continue where you left off, or start a new event from scratch.

step1.title: Event & room
step1.drawHint: Drag the gold handles to expand or shrink the room footprint. Switch back to fields anytime.
step1.inputModeFieldsHint: Type width, length, and ceiling height
step1.inputModeDrawHint: Drag handles on the room preview canvas
step1.bundleHint: Adds recommended setups to your brief in one tap
step1.upsellWedding: Weddings in this size often add a ceremony backdrop + entrance drape.
step1.upsellCorporate: Corporate events often soften two walls and add a stage backdrop.
step1.upsellDefault: Planning brief — our team will follow up with a rental estimate.

step2.title: Visual setup catalog
step2.description: Tap photo cards to add setups. This is not a cart — just your planning brief.

step3.title: Look & add-ons
step3.description: Choose fabric direction, color, and fullness. No prices shown here.
step3.noPricing: Planning brief only — not final pricing.

step4.title: Review your brief
step4.description: Open Studio to refine in 2D/3D, or submit now with the details below.
step4.noSetups: No setups selected yet — you can add them in Studio.
step4.disclaimer: Planning brief only — not final pricing. We confirm measurements and availability after venue review.
step4.ctaEstimate: Prefer a quick form? Get estimate
step4.keepTabHint: Studio and Get Estimate open in new tabs so this plan stays here. Your answers are saved in this browser.

validation.eventType: Select an event type to continue.
validation.roomSize: Enter valid room dimensions (at least 10 ft).

submit.title: Submit your event plan
submit.description: We will email a confirmation and follow up within 24–48 hours.
submit.name: Full name
submit.noPricing: No pricing on this form — our team prepares your rental estimate after review.
submit.updateDescription: Save your latest room, setups, and fabric choices. Our team will review the updated brief.
submit.errorGeneric: We could not submit your plan. Please try again.

success.title: Your event plan is on its way to our team
success.description: Thank you — we received your event draping brief and will review room details, setups, and fabric choices.
success.step1: Our team reviews your room layout and selected setups.
success.step2: We follow up by email with questions or a rental estimate conversation.
success.step3: When you're ready, we coordinate delivery, installation, and teardown.
success.disclaimer: Planning brief only — not final pricing until we confirm venue details.
success.guestCta: Create an account to track your event plan
success.customerCta: View your plan in your account
